before: The suggestions-only policy refused a party's words in the part of a link or a content control that another person's pending Enter split off as nested, though Word marks only the new paragraph mark there and the host's check allows them.
after: The edge that Enter puts in to split a link or a control is no insertion of the container, so a party's words in the part it split off are judged as words in the file's container and allowed.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format does not change. The room refuses fewer changes; every copy applies the change log with the same code version, so the copies agree. Checkpoints do not change. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet, so no room needs a migration.
